headline: Penn State Behrend stands alone without a defeat
dek: Across all matches, Penn State Behrend has won four and drawn one without a loss, conceding just one goal while scoring twelve. Seven different scorers have carried the attack, giving the program an unbeaten record that no other AMCC side matches.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring in the conference splits sharply at the top: Mount Aloysius has scored 46 goals across fourteen different players, more than Hilbert, Penn State Behrend, La Roche, Pitt-Bradford, Penn State Altoona, and Carlow combined.

wire.line: Conference programs have won seven, drawn seven, and lost fifteen against outside opponents, scoring 42 goals and conceding 55.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches have passed their scheduled dates with no published result, and both belong to Pitt-Greensburg: home against Bethany and away at Seton Hill.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pitt-Greensburg forward Matt Armenio has scored fourteen goals and added two assists on 44 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hilbert goalkeeper Colten Wolowski has made 96 saves while conceding 48 goals for a 0.667 save percentage.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Carlow has lost all three of its matches without scoring, conceding fourteen goals.

last_match.line: The loss closes Pitt-Greensburg's season on a losing streak without a win since its victory at Penn State Altoona.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
